summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing for Phase 15 (Admin Auto-Pilot Queue Management) and Phase 16 (User-Generated Learning Paths). All 28 core API tests passed successfully (100% success rate).

flaky_endpoints.issue: LLM API hitting concurrent request limits during path lesson generation
flaky_endpoints.symptoms: Rate limit errors (429) when multiple paths are being filled simultaneously
flaky_endpoints.impact: Background lesson content generation may fail for some lessons, but the hourly sweep will retry
flaky_endpoints.workaround: Concurrency is already limited to 2, and there's an hourly retry sweep. This is expected behavior under load.

passed_tests: Authentication: Admin and sage test users login successfully
PHASE 15: GET /api/admin/auto/queue - Lists queue items correctly
PHASE 15: POST /api/admin/auto/queue/{id}/regenerate - Successfully regenerates FAILED items
PHASE 15: POST /api/admin/auto/queue/{id}/regenerate - Returns 404 for non-existent items
PHASE 15: POST /api/admin/auto/queue/{id}/reject - Rejects items with reason and timestamp
PHASE 15: Admin auth enforcement - All 3 endpoints return 403 for non-admin users
PHASE 16: GET /api/paths - Anonymous users see only public/approved paths (no security leaks)
PHASE 16: GET /api/paths - Authenticated users see public paths + their own private/pending/rejected paths
PHASE 16: POST /api/paths/generate - Goal validation works (too short < 8 chars returns 400)
PHASE 16: POST /api/paths/generate - Goal validation works (too long > 2000 chars returns 400)
PHASE 16: POST /api/paths/generate - Paid (sage tier) user successfully generates custom path
PHASE 16: GET /api/paths/mine - Returns all paths created by the user
PHASE 16: GET /api/paths/{id} - Creator can view their pending_review path

PHASE 16: POST /api/admin/notifications/{id}/mark-read - Marks notification as read
PHASE 16: POST /api/admin/paths/{id}/approve - Approves path with notes and tier override

additional_notes.test_coverage: Comprehensive backend API testing completed for both Phase 15 and Phase 16 features
